description: Create and manage Y.GY short links, QR codes, and routing settings.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Y.GY API key sent with the api-key header. Create one in Dashboard > My Account > API Keys as documented at https://app.y.gy/docs/api-docs/authenticate.

actions.name: create_link
actions.description: Create a Y.GY short link with optional QR, security, and routing settings.

destination_url.description: The destination URL or hostname/path that Y.GY should redirect to.

domain.description: A verified Y.GY custom domain, or y.gy when omitted.

suffix.description: The preferred custom suffix for the short link.

password.description: The password required to access the short link.

og_title.description: The updated title used in social link previews.

og_description.description: The updated description used in social link previews.

og_image.description: The updated image URL used in social link previews.

expiration_date.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the short link should expire.

qr_code_foreground_hex.description: The six-digit foreground color for the QR code.

qr_code_background_hex.description: The six-digit background color for the QR code.

name.description: An internal name for the short link.

tags.description: Tag identifiers to associate with the short link.

android_link_destination.description: The destination URL used for Android visitors.

ios_link_destination.description: The destination URL used for iOS visitors.

webhook_url.description: The URL that Y.GY should notify with real-time link updates.

webhook_auth_key.description: The authentication key Y.GY should use for webhook requests.

disable_png.description: Whether Y.GY should skip PNG generation and return only the SVG QR code.

inputSchema.description: Input payload for creating a Y.GY short link.

created_at.description: The timestamp string returned by Y.GY for link creation.

suffix.description: The path suffix used by the short link.
